name: Necromancer: a raise at full Life Force replaces the oldest minion (#5889)
contract: Life Force 805011 is a stacked aura whose stack count is the capacity (Spell.dbc StackAmount 2, raised only by
SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS passives such as Master Animator 504431 and Scourge Apprentice Training 680283, which
this fixture does not learn); Free Life Force 525004 carries the free amount and is removed at 0. Raise: Lesser
Skeletal Warrior 500970 (50065), Raise: Skeletal Rogue 500969 (50078) and Raise: Ghoul 500971 (50073) each read
'occupying 1 Life Force'; Raise: Abomination 500335 (50068) reads 'occupying 3 Life Force'. #5889 asks that a
raise at full Life Force cycles the new minion in, and the maintainer chose that the oldest raised minions are
unsummoned until the new one fits. A level-60 Necromancer with capacity 2 raises a warrior and then a rogue,
which fills its Life Force. A Ghoul raised at full Life Force must appear while the warrior, the oldest, is
unsummoned and the rogue stays. A raise that can never fit, an Abomination costing 3 against a capacity of 2, is
still refused with SPELL_FAILED_ALREADY_HAVE_SUMMON (7) before mana is spent, and unsummons nothing.

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura synchronize
PRECONDITION: Life Force capacity is 2 without Life Force talents
Raise the oldest minion, a Lesser Skeletal Warrior
SETUP: one Lesser Skeletal Warrior
Clear the global cooldown
Raise a Skeletal Rogue to fill the Life Force
SETUP: one Skeletal Rogue
PRECONDITION: no Life Force is left free
Clear the global cooldown
Raise a Ghoul at full Life Force
DISCRIMINATING: the Ghoul is raised at full Life Force
The raise at full Life Force was not refused
DISCRIMINATING: the oldest minion, the warrior, is unsummoned
The newer Skeletal Rogue stays
The capacity is unchanged
The Life Force is full again
Clear the global cooldown
Raise an Abomination (3 Life Force) at capacity 2
A minion that can never fit is refused as SPELL_FAILED_ALREADY_HAVE_SUMMON (7)
The refused raise spends no mana
Outlast the Abomination cast time
No Abomination was raised
The refused raise unsummons no Ghoul
The refused raise unsummons no Skeletal Rogue
